cases.case_label: AluYa5 (352 bp) in coding exon 43 of EYS
cases.mechanism_detail: A heterozygous AluYa5 insertion (282 bp Alu, 56-bp poly(T), 15-bp TSD) in EYS coding exon 43, found by targeted nanopore sequencing in trans with a founder exon 32-33 deletion, is predicted to add 39 aberrant amino acids followed by a premature stop codon.
cases.quote: The Alu insertion disrupting the coding exon 43 would, if translated, result in an insertion of 39 aberrant amino acids followed by a premature
